description: This Java class, TestSupportFactory, provides utility methods for setting up and creating test objects related to an e-commerce system, such as products, categories, countries, currencies, languages, stores, product types, and manufacturers. It is used specifically for testing purposes within the project.

classes.name: TestSupportFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing factory methods for creating and setting up test objects for various entities within the e-commerce system, facilitating unit testing and data setup.

methods.name: createAndStoreRandomProduct
methods.description: Creates and persists a random product with associated description, availability, and price, using provided manufacturer, type, category, store, and language.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Creates a category object with given parent, store, and languages, initializing its description and hierarchical properties.

methods.name: createCountry
methods.description: Creates a country object with descriptions in a specified language.

methods.name: createCurrency
methods.description: Creates a currency object supported in the system.

methods.name: createLanguage
methods.description: Creates a language object with the specified language code.

methods.name: createMerchantStore
methods.description: Creates a merchant store instance with specified details including country, currency, language, name, and email.

methods.name: createProductType
methods.description: Creates a product type object with a general type code.

methods.name: createRandomManufacturer
methods.description: Creates a manufacturer with a random name and description in a given language for a specific store.
